messages:
maria: Quick sync 1: need to finalize the streaming handoff microflow before tomorrow's review. Noticed stop button flashes when tokens stream rapidly.

sam: I saw that too. Feels like the stop control competes with token updates. Users might miss it during bursts. :thinking_face:

kevin: Current impl slides the toolbar in from the right and the token counter reflows, causing the perceived jitter. Two options: pin counter to left of toolbar, or make counter a compact pill that doesn't affect layout.

maria: Leaning toward compact pill. Also consider lowering its visual weight while streaming so the message text stays primary. We have telemetry that most users glance tokens after generation finishes.

nora: A11y check: ensure the stop control has a consistent accessible name even if the visible label toggles. Screen reader users can get disoriented if the button text changes. Prefer stable aria-labels and update state via aria-pressed or aria-live.

kevin: Example snippet I can add to the prototype: ```html
<button aria-label="stream-stop" id="stop-btn">Stop</button>
<button aria-label="stream-regen" id="regen-btn">Regenerate</button>
```

sam: Do we show both buttons simultaneously? That might look busy. Perhaps show Stop during streaming, then swap in Regenerate + token summary after finish. Keyboard users should get a focus hint when Regen appears.

maria: Agreed 1: single primary action during streaming. Product question: should the token pill be visible while streaming for cost-aware users, or hidden until completion?

kevin: Technically we can expose a collapsed pill with an abbreviated count (e.g., "78 tok") that expands on hover/focus. Keeps layout stable and minimal. I'll prototype a low-contrast pill with reduced font weight during streaming.

nora: Contrast must meet at least 3:1 for the collapsed state and 4.5:1 when expanded if it contains action text. Tab order: ensure Stop is first focus target during stream. When the pill expands on focus, don't trap keyboard users.

maria: Copy tweak: on small screens maybe use full label "Stop generation" instead of icon-only. For icon-only variants always include visible tooltip + aria-label.

sam: Animation timing nit: handoff transition is too fast. Users barely notice that stream finished and regen popped in. Suggest toolbar opacity transition of 160ms and 40ms stagger for the token pill to avoid competing motion.

kevin: I'll implement 160ms ease-out for the toolbar with prefers-reduced-motion media query respect, and a 40ms delay for the pill.

maria: Prompt library placement 1: current mock puts it on right shelf. Some PMs prefer left rail for reachability on wide screens. Thoughts?

sam: Right shelf is fine, but when playground narrows the shelf overlays controls. Could we implement it as a drawer that pushes content on larger screens and as bottom sheet on mobile?

kevin: Drawer + push on desktop, bottom sheet on mobile is doable. Also ensure when drawer animates we remove pointer events from underlying stream area.

nora: Focus management is important: move focus into drawer on open and return to invoker on close. Announce state changes with polite aria-live: "Prompt drawer opened". Add keyboard shortcut hint.

maria: Action items: Kevin 1: prototype with screenshots for small/large breakpoints. Sam: update Figma with reduced-weight counter and timing changes. Nora: add accessibility checklist to ticket. Designbot: create ticket.

designbot: Created ticket PL-4921: "Stream handoff: stop/regenerate timing, token pill, prompt drawer a11y" with checklist items.

kevin: Will post prototype link and screenshots by EOD.

sam: Thanks all 1 :thumbsup:
